decisions.reason: After another year on the market, this core bread line is further backed by sunk effort and a visible standalone presentation, so management would likely continue it absent clear evidence of failure.
As a publicly emphasized flagship stollen with external award recognition, it carries the strongest reputational commitment and is therefore extremely unlikely to be withdrawn.
Although it overlaps with other rye breads, its close fit with the established assortment and the firm's prior decision to retain it make continued commitment more likely than reversal.
This seasonal stollen remains somewhat more droppable because of overlap with the stronger flagship, but its proximity to the confectionery core and repeated retention still favor keeping it.
The ancient grain bread was publicly framed as a new Meisterstück, and with no reported disappointment management would tend to justify and extend that commitment rather than abandon it.
